scenes.tts: Two routes feed one axon. How can you tell which route makes which part of the firing?
scenes.visual: Title card: Take One Route Away. The two-arrow diagram: the ending's Piezo2 and the Merkel cell's synapse, both feeding one axon.
scenes.narration: Two routes feed one axon. How can you tell which route makes which part of the firing?

scenes.tts: Take one route away, and watch which phase is left. Here, the route taken away is always the Merkel cell's.
scenes.visual: The Merkel-cell arrow fades out; the ending's arrow stays. The SA1 raster below waits to redraw. Text: remove the Merkel-cell route, read the phases.
scenes.narration: Take one route away, and watch which phase is left. Here, the route taken away is always the Merkel cell's.

scenes.tts: The recordings come from mouse skin, kept alive in a bath with its nerve attached.
scenes.visual: A patch of skin in a dish of bath solution, its nerve led to an electrode. Label: ex vivo skin-nerve preparation, mouse touch domes.
scenes.narration: The recordings come from mouse skin, kept alive in a bath with its nerve attached.

scenes.tts: An electrode records one afferent while a probe presses the skin.
scenes.visual: A probe presses, holds and lifts above the skin; one afferent's spikes appear as ticks on the screen.
scenes.narration: An electrode records one afferent while a probe presses the skin.

scenes.tts: The recorded afferent lacks the light-activated proteins. Light aimed at the touch dome, plus controls, ties the effects to Merkel cells.
scenes.visual: Light is aimed at the touch dome. The Merkel cells glow; the recorded afferent does not. Label: recorded afferent lacks the opsin; controls support a Merkel-cell effect.
scenes.narration: The recorded afferent lacks the light-activated proteins. Light aimed at the touch dome, plus controls, ties the effects to Merkel cells.

scenes.tts: First test. Light aimed at the Merkel cells depolarizes them, with no touch at all.
scenes.visual: A table appears with columns: manipulation, onset, hold. Row 1: light depolarizes Merkel cells, no touch.
scenes.narration: First test. Light aimed at the Merkel cells depolarizes them, with no touch at all.

scenes.tts: The afferent fires. The Merkel cell is enough to drive it.
scenes.visual: Ticks appear under the light bar with no probe. Row 1 fills: the afferent fires; the cell is sufficient.
scenes.narration: The afferent fires. The Merkel cell is enough to drive it.

scenes.tts: Second test. Light silences the Merkel cells during a held press. What do you expect to lose?
scenes.visual: Row 2: light silences Merkel cells during touch. Its onset and hold cells are blank.
scenes.narration: Second test. Light silences the Merkel cells during a held press. What do you expect to lose?

scenes.tts: The sustained firing is suppressed. The hold needs the Merkel cell in the moment.
scenes.visual: The raster redraws: the hold becomes much sparser, a few ticks left. Row 2, hold column fills: sustained firing suppressed. A small note: median tenfold fall, 3 units.
scenes.narration: The sustained firing is suppressed. The hold needs the Merkel cell in the moment.

scenes.tts: Third test. Delete Piezo two from the skin's epithelium, but not from the nerve.
scenes.visual: Row 3: Piezo2 deleted from skin epithelium. The channel icon on the Merkel cell is crossed out; the one on the ending stays.
scenes.caption: Third test. Delete Piezo2 from the skin's epithelium, but not from the nerve.
scenes.narration: Third test. Delete Piezo2 from the skin's epithelium, but not from the nerve.

scenes.tts: In culture, Merkel cells without epithelial Piezo two lose their touch-evoked current. The ending keeps its channel. Predict what is left.
scenes.visual: Row 3's onset and hold cells are blank. Text: Merkel cell route off; ending route on.
scenes.narration: In culture, Merkel cells without epithelial Piezo2 lose their touch-evoked current. The ending keeps its channel. Predict what is left.
scenes.caption: In culture, Merkel cells without epithelial Piezo2 lose their touch-evoked current. The ending keeps its channel. Predict what is left.

scenes.tts: The onset stays similar to controls. The hold loses its normal sustained firing. That is the cleanest split.
scenes.visual: The raster redraws with a comparable onset burst, then sparse firing that thins through the hold. Row 3 fills: onset similar to controls; normal sustained firing lost, hold firing reduced.
scenes.narration: The onset stays similar to controls. The hold loses its normal sustained firing. That is the cleanest split.

scenes.tts: One limit. This deletion covers all of the skin's epithelium, not only the Merkel cells.
scenes.visual: The whole epidermis tints to show where the deletion acts. Label: an epithelial Cre driver acts in all skin epithelium.
scenes.narration: One limit. This deletion covers all of the skin's epithelium, not only the Merkel cells.

scenes.tts: Fourth test. Remove the Merkel cells altogether, by deleting the gene Atoh one during development.
scenes.visual: Row 4: Atoh1 deleted in development. The touch dome redraws with no Merkel cells; the ending remains.
scenes.caption: Fourth test. Remove the Merkel cells altogether, by deleting the gene Atoh1 during development.
scenes.narration: Fourth test. Remove the Merkel cells altogether, by deleting the gene Atoh1 during development.

scenes.tts: The afferents still respond to touch. But the hold is cut short, before the press ends. That is called intermediately adapting.
scenes.visual: The raster redraws: a burst, some firing into the hold, then silence before the probe lifts. Label: intermediately adapting.
scenes.narration: The afferents still respond to touch. But the hold is cut short, before the press ends. That is called intermediately adapting.

scenes.tts: And the onset falls too. Peak firing drops to about a third of normal.
scenes.visual: Row 4 fills: onset lower; hold cut short. A bar for peak firing shrinks to about a third of the control bar. On screen: 238 to 79 Hz, group means.
scenes.narration: And the onset falls too. Peak firing drops to about a third of normal.

scenes.tts: That row only partly fits. A developmental loss cannot say whether the cell's own signal, or a changed skin, caused it.
scenes.visual: Row 4 is outlined in amber with the label: fits only partly. Text: developmental deletion: mechanism unknown.
scenes.narration: That row only partly fits. A developmental loss cannot say whether the cell's own signal, or a changed skin, caused it.

scenes.tts: Blocking vesicle release in the epidermis, with tetanus toxin, also reduced both phases.
scenes.visual: A fifth line under the table: release blocked with tetanus toxin: onset lower, hold lower. Label: Hoffman and colleagues.
scenes.narration: Blocking vesicle release in the epidermis, with tetanus toxin, also reduced both phases.

scenes.tts: So release, probably from Merkel cells, may help with the onset too.
scenes.visual: The dynamic and static boxes on the raster each show two arrows, one thick and one thin. Text: release matters for both phases.
scenes.narration: So release, probably from Merkel cells, may help with the onset too.

scenes.tts: That is why the idea says mainly. In mouse touch domes, the ending mainly feels the change, and the Merkel cell mainly holds the press. Neither acts alone.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the finished table beside the line: which input dominates, not an exclusive split.
scenes.narration: That is why the idea says mainly. In mouse touch domes, the ending mainly feels the change, and the Merkel cell mainly holds the press. Neither acts alone.
